docs:
## Installation

```bash
npx shadcn add @akoder/bookshelf
```

Pass your own book data and cover/spine image URLs to Bookshelf. No portfolio config or artwork is required. The CSS module and motion helper are installed together. See https://akoder.xyz/components/bookshelf for a complete usage example and props reference.
